title: scene.nodeRemoved (publisher → relay → viewers)
description: Nodes removed from the scene; viewers dispose geometry and material of T/M and drop the ids from their list (docs/protocol.md §8.2). Version rules as for scene.update (§8.1, §8.4).

nodeIds.description: Stable ids of the removed nodes, 1..1000 per message (§3.3 max changes).
